title: Multiple Leak Localization in Water Distribution Networks through Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.35972v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Leak localization in water distribution networks is challenging when multiple leaks occur simultaneously, particularly under sparse monitoring. Existing data-driven methods often assume a single or predefined number of leaks or require extensive enumeration of leak combinations. This study proposes a graph neural network (GNN) model that localizes a variable number of simultaneous leaks without specifying the leak count in advance or exhaustively generating every possible combination of leak locations for training. The model is evaluated on two benchmark networks of different sizes, the 31-node Hanoi network and the larger 92-node NET3 network, under variable demand, sparse pressure-sensor coverage, variable leak magnitudes, and varying numbers of simultaneous leaks. The GNN outperforms multilayer perceptron, support vector machine, K-nearest neighbors, and random forest classifiers by up to 12% and 20% in accuracy respectively in Hano

translated_title: 基于图神经网络的供水管网多泄漏点定位方法
translated_abstract: 当供水管网中同时发生多个泄漏时，泄漏定位极具挑战性，尤其是在监测设备稀疏的情况下。现有的数据驱动方法通常假设泄漏数量为单一或预先确定，或者需要对泄漏组合进行大量的枚举。本研究提出了一种图神经网络模型，能够定位数量可变的同时泄漏，既无需提前指定泄漏数量，也无需在训练时穷举所有可能的泄漏位置组合。该模型在两个不同规模的基准网络上进行了评估：31个节点的哈诺伊网络和更大的92个节点NET3网络，评估条件包括需求变化、稀疏的压力传感器覆盖、可变的泄漏幅度以及不同数量的同时泄漏。GNN的性能优于多层感知机、支持向量机、K近邻和随机森林分类器，准确率分别提高了12%和20%。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种图神经网络模型，无需预先指定泄漏数量或穷举泄漏位置组合，即可在稀疏压力监测条件下定位供水管网中数量可变的多个同时泄漏，其准确率比传统机器学习方法最高提升12%和20%。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a graph neural network model that localizes a variable number of simultaneous leaks in water distribution networks under sparse pressure monitoring, without specifying the leak count in advance or exhaustively enumerating leak combinations, outperforming traditional machine learning classifiers by up to 12% and 20% in accuracy.
